attchmntText: Arihant Capital Markets Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Arihant Capital Markets Limited has scheduled a Board Meeting for Wednesday, 18th November, 2026. The agenda includes considering and approving a proposal to sponsor and set up a Mutual Fund, following in-principle approval from SEBI. The board will also review the proposed business structure, implementation framework, and the potential incorporation of a subsidiary company, including an Asset Management Company and Trustee Company. Other incidental matters and authorizations for directors and key managerial personnel are also on the agenda. The trading window for dealing in company securities is closed immediately for designated persons and their immediate relatives. This closure remains in effect until 48 hours after the information is made publicly available.
